## Triage: grade completed, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:services` · `area:records`, into `pm:queue`. Log at `error` per the AGENTS.md rule; failing the boot is not taken here

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T02:53Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **The filer's labels stand.** Triage adds `area:records` and `pm:queue`. `provisionSystemTables` in `plugin-audit` is `domain:services`.
- **Why p2:** a deployment can run with no `sys_activity` or `sys_audit_log` table while looking healthy. That is the durability class the governing text names. The evidence is one unexplained CI sighting, so the defect is the log level, not a measured loss.
- **Direction:**
  - The failed provisioning logs at `error`, once per object. Its first line carries ① the consequence (which audit table is not durable, and that the deployment keeps looking healthy) and ② the fix (what restores it, such as `os migrate apply`).
  - ⛔ **Failing the boot is not taken here.** Making a boot refuse is a new refusal, and that is a separate call for whoever owns boot policy. A new gate defaults to no. The `error` line is what the rule asks for.
- **Pins:**
  - A forced `syncObjectSchema` failure on one audit object produces that `error` line.
  - CONTROL: a clean provision logs no `error`.
  - The card's optional item, printing the `serve` child's stderr on failure in `plan.telemetry-sibling.integration.test.ts`, rides along. It is test-only and names the cause of the next recurrence.
- `Clause-②: no`.

Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `S, not mechanical (the error line's consequence and fix wording is the judgment) ⇒ M treatment`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack: "no path-derived mandate … The tier stays the PM's per-card judgment call"`
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `plugin-audit`'s own `provisionSystemTables` (this lane's code) produces it | none: no other path says at boot that an audit table is missing; `os migrate plan` lists it only when an operator runs it | any deployment whose audit-table DDL throws at boot reaches it (one unexplained sighting, merge-queue build 38185050868); nobody relies on the `warn` today
Thread-read: 6116902332
Serial constraints cleared: no open PR touches `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/**` or `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/**` (the file lists of all 23 non-release open PRs, read at this claim). The in-flight #22870 PR 2 (claim `6118835291`) declares `plugin-audit/src/comment-access-hooks.ts` only, which is disjoint. Epic #15204's territory names no `plugin-audit` file. The seat's hot-file queue on `plugin-audit` (#22590 item 3's interim C) touches `parent-record-read-gate.ts` and `activity-field-redaction.ts`, also disjoint.

Direction carried into the order is triage's grade `6116902332`, quoted there: the failed provisioning logs at `error`, once per object, and ⛔ failing the boot is not taken. No maintainer ruling exists on this card.

## Seat ACCEPT: PR #22981 at `9ac3a46f5` · landing waits on a green head

`domain:services` seat 1 · `session_01CeRCvvvjxbxu2iYJAc5Cce` · 2026-10-12T07:47Z, under claim `6119084257`. The dev's report is the `os-dev-report` above. Checked on GitHub and on `origin/main`, not from the report.

**Checklist**
- **PR form:** draft, base `main`; the first line is `Fixes #22913`, the second `Clause-②: no`. No other card number sits near a closing keyword. The assignee is `os-warren`.
- **Scope:** 4 files, +193 / −26, exactly the claim's surface: `audit-plugin.ts`, `audit-plugin.test.ts`, the cli telemetry-sibling integration test (test-only) and `.changeset/22913-audit-provision-failure-error.md`. - **Changeset:** a `patch` for `@objectstack/plugin-audit`, read sentence by sentence against the diff. "logged at `error`, once per object per boot and never per write" matches the catch. "The boot is still not failed" matches `continue`. The meta `{ object, error }` sentence matches the call. "A log search on `could not provision sys_activity storage` … still matches" holds: the message keeps that prefix.
- **Spot checks:**
  - The catch's call is `ctx.logger.error(line, undefined, { object, error })`. On `origin/main`, core's `ObjectLogger.error(message, errorOrMeta?, meta?)` dispatches through `writeErrorLike`, whose docblock records that the third argument is read when the second is `undefined`. The dev's end-to-end boot printed the meta.
  - A4's stop branch is evidenced on `origin/main` `a2240c4dc`: `calleeName()` in `scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` returns the property name, so `sync.call(engine, …)` reads as `call`. The three sites the entry would light each call `engine.syncObjectSchema(…)` directly (read in `schema-migration-plugins.ts`, `protocol.ts` and `datasource-connection-service.ts`).
- **Pins and ablations:** the four per-object `error` pins and the CONTROL are in the diff. Both ablations and the ride-along proof are quoted in the PR body with their failure output, and the restores are proved by blob.
- **Deviations accepted:**
  - A4 branch 2, as the order required.
  - Model-free commit trailers, per AGENTS.md.
  - One shallow `git fetch` of a pinned control commit into the shared object store; no ref moved.
  - `mcp_calls` is 0.

**CI on `9ac3a46f5`** (read at this comment, latest run per check name):
- `TypeScript Type Check` is `success`.
- `Lint & Repo Gates` is `failure`, on one step: "Write-pace throttle self-test". One case of 113 failed, a wall-clock gap of 149 ms against a 150 ms floor, in code this PR does not touch; the same battery's exact stamp case passed, and the self-test passed 113 of 113 in a seat container. It is not this PR's failure. Filed as #22986.
- Two `Test Core` shards were still running.

**Out-of-scope findings**
- `OS_SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC` is not honoured by `provisionSystemTables`: filed #22984.
- The `service-messaging` twin, plus the `service-datasource`, `metadata-protocol` and `cli` sites and the checker's `.call` blind spot: filed #22985, one family card with five members.
- objectql printing one refused object twice per boot: Acceptance notes (carrier: none).
- The stale "lazy-created on first WRITE" text in the no-`syncObjectSchema` branch, and the `NO datasource driver` branch left at `warn`: Acceptance notes (carrier: none).
